recommendations.headline: Satisfaction is the single biggest lever on sales: satisfied calls close at 72% versus 15% for neutral and only 5% for dissatisfied, yet 52% of all 2,483 calls (1,285) end merely neutral and reps leave 394 calls with no fixed follow-up and 230 with no quote sent.
behaviour: Price comparison dominates customer behaviour (price_shopper 431, comparing_quotes 256) but price is explicitly discussed in only 30% of calls (741 of 2,483; 1,742 'not_discussed') - most price objections (339, top objection) arise from lack of proactive pricing, not rejection.
46% of calls (1,142) end in 'callback' versus 20% (485) ending in an order - indecision is structural, reinforced by 159 'indecisive' and 378 'unclear' outcomes.
High urgency exists in only 14% of calls (339) but urgent_buyer behaviour appears in 269 calls - these time-sensitive buyers are a distinct, high-value group needing instant response.
Technical questions are common (needs_technical_help 354, technical_advice need 397) showing many buyers need specification guidance before committing, not just price.

Dealers are 48% of volume (1,186 calls) and convert best among known segments (41%), while the 'unknown' segment (911 calls, 37% of total) converts worst (25%) - a large share of traffic is never properly qualified.
satisfaction: Only 35% of calls (876) end 'satisfied', 52% (1,285) are neutral and 8% (211) dissatisfied - the majority of conversations fail to build confidence either way.
Satisfaction is the strongest predictor of sales: satisfied calls win 72% of the time vs 15% for neutral and 5% for dissatisfied - a >14x gap between satisfied and dissatisfied.

Price is rarely resolved cleanly: only 11% of calls (273) end with price 'accepted', 16% (391) are 'negotiating', and 70% (1,742) never discuss price at all - this suggests pricing conversations, not price itself, are the gap.
Even when price_high is raised (339 calls), win rate is just 28%, and transport_cost (21%) and min_quantity (15%) objections convert even worse - value communication around these objections is weak.

conversion.title: Close every call with a fixed next step
conversion.evidence: 394 calls show 'no_follow_up_fixed' and 46% of all calls (1,142) end as 'callback'
conversion.action: Mandate reps state and log a specific day/time for the next contact before ending any call, especially for callback/unclear outcomes.

conversion.title: Always ask for the order
conversion.evidence: 227 calls show 'didnt_ask_for_order', while order_pct is only 20%
conversion.action: Train reps to explicitly ask for confirmation or next commitment at the end of every price/product enquiry call.

conversion.title: Send a quote immediately, not 'later'
conversion.evidence: 230 calls show 'no_quote_sent'; price_enquiry is the top intent (849 calls, 34%)
conversion.action: Require a WhatsApp/written quote to be sent during or within minutes of every price enquiry call; track time-to-quote.

conversion.title: Fix slow/unclear responses
conversion.evidence: 407 calls flagged 'slow_or_unclear_answer', the single largest rep miss
conversion.action: Build a quick-reference rate/spec sheet for reps so common questions (rate per kg/sqm, GSM, colors) are answered instantly and clearly.

conversion.title: Qualify 'unknown' segment callers early
conversion.evidence: Unknown segment is 37% of calls (911) but converts at only 25% vs 41% for dealers; 96 calls show 'didnt_ask_requirement'
conversion.action: Add a mandatory 2-question segment/requirement check (buyer type, quantity, timeline) at call start to route and prioritise correctly.

conversion.title: Counter price/competitor objections with value, not discount
conversion.evidence: price_high (339 calls, 28% win) and competitor_cheaper (89 calls, 24% win) are the top two blockers after stock
conversion.action: Equip reps with 3 ready value points (JSW authorisation, quality assurance, consistent supply) to use whenever price or competitor objections surface; avoid conceding on price without logging it.

conversion.title: Prioritise urgent and stock-sensitive calls
conversion.evidence: Stock_availability is the 2nd highest objection (333 calls, 26% win) and top need (452); high urgency is 339 calls
conversion.action: Create a same-day escalation lane for high-urgency/stock-check calls so reps give real-time stock status instead of 'will check and call back'.

offers.title: Instant quotation service
offers.for_whom: Price enquiry callers (849 calls, 34% of total)
offers.why: 230 calls had 'no_quote_sent'; quote delay is a recurring frustration in non-converted call summaries.

offers.title: Guaranteed same-day/site delivery slot
offers.why: fast_delivery is the top need (461) and site_delivery need is 104; multiple summaries show delivery timing as the deciding factor.

offers.title: On-demand cutting/processing service
offers.for_whom: Fabricators and contractors needing custom sizes
offers.why: cutting_processing need appears 101 times and several successful calls converted after cutting was offered.

offers.title: Dedicated bulk-order account handling
offers.why: bulk_buyer behaviour (223) and dealer segment (1,186 calls, 41% win) are high-value, high-volume groups.

offers.title: Consider structured credit terms
offers.why: needs_credit (96) and credit_terms objection (73) actually has the highest win rate among objections (29%), suggesting credit flexibility converts well.

offers.title: Technical advisory support line
offers.why: technical_advice is the 3rd highest need (397) and needs_technical_help behaviour is 354.

loyalty.title: Formalise festival gifting scheme
loyalty.how: Track and proactively offer seasonal gifts (as already seen with JSW fan/cooler promotions) to repeat dealers at order confirmation
loyalty.why: Diwali gift was proactively asked about in multiple calls, showing goodwill gestures matter to customers.

loyalty.title: Repeat-buyer recognition tier
loyalty.how: Flag repeat_buyer accounts (220 calls) for priority call handling and faster dispatch
loyalty.why: Repeat buyers are a large share of callers (220) but loyal_to_us tag is rare (19), showing loyalty isn't yet being reinforced.

loyalty.title: Proactive rate/stock update broadcast
loyalty.how: Send a regular WhatsApp update on rates, new stock, and colors to known dealers
loyalty.why: regular_updates is needed by 207 callers - proactive info reduces repeat 'what's the rate' calls.

loyalty.title: Referral reward programme
loyalty.how: Formally track and reward customers who refer others
loyalty.why: Referral behaviour already occurs organically in 27 calls - formalising it can scale this channel.

loyalty.title: Dedicated relationship manager for top dealers
loyalty.how: Assign named rep contact for consistent supply and faster query resolution
loyalty.why: consistent_supply need (121) and dealer's high win rate (41%) show dealers are worth retaining with personalised service.

loyalty.title: Fast-track documentation delivery
loyalty.how: Automatically attach test certificates/invoices via WhatsApp with every dispatch
loyalty.why: test_certificate need (19) and specific requests to send documents via WhatsApp appear in call summaries.

non_price_benefits.title: Authorised JSW distributor / quality assurance
non_price_benefits.why: quality_doubt is an objection in 93 calls and quality_assurance is a need in 126 calls - authenticity reassurance is valuable.

non_price_benefits.title: Fast and reliable delivery
non_price_benefits.why: fast_delivery is the top customer need (461 mentions) across calls.

non_price_benefits.title: Technical and specification guidance
non_price_benefits.why: technical_advice (397) and needs_technical_help (354) show many buyers value expert input, not just price.

non_price_benefits.title: Wide colour/brand range (Color On Plus, Pragathi, Indradhanush, GI, polycarbonate)
non_price_benefits.why: Frequent colour/variant-specific questions across calls indicate choice is a differentiator.

non_price_benefits.title: Custom cutting and processing capability
non_price_benefits.why: cutting_processing need (101) and successful calls where cutting was offered led to confirmed orders.

non_price_benefits.title: Consistent stock availability
non_price_benefits.why: stock_availability is both the top need (452) and 2nd highest objection (333) - reliable stock is a key trust driver.

top_questions.question: What is the price/rate for this product (per kg, sqft, or sqm)?
top_questions.answer_tip: Give a clear, immediate answer with unit basis and GST status; avoid 'will check and call back' where possible.

top_questions.question: Is this colour/size/thickness in stock right now?
top_questions.answer_tip: Confirm real-time stock status and offer closest alternative immediately if unavailable.

top_questions.question: Can you deliver today or tomorrow?
top_questions.answer_tip: Give a specific delivery window and confirm via follow-up message rather than a vague promise.

top_questions.question: Can you match or beat a competitor's price?
top_questions.answer_tip: Redirect to value points - authorised JSW distribution, consistent supply, quality assurance - rather than discussing discounts.

top_questions.question: Can you send the quotation/proforma invoice?
top_questions.answer_tip: Send the quote in writing (WhatsApp) during the call itself, not as a promise for later.

top_questions.question: Will you confirm and call me back?
top_questions.answer_tip: Always commit to and log an exact day/time for follow-up rather than an open-ended promise.

top_questions.question: Is there a festival gift/promotion available?
top_questions.answer_tip: Confirm current scheme status honestly; offer to check and update proactively via WhatsApp.

top_questions.question: Can cutting/customisation be done today?
top_questions.answer_tip: Clarify turnaround time clearly and confirm feasibility before the customer commits to the order.
